confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Jamaican resort-town pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant, coffee, and drink anchors are moderately grounded; the hostel anchors are least certain because Ocho Rios has few registered hostels. Accommodation rates are July-dependent and may shift with demand. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of bar prices is limited. FX: the 0.6955 USD per AUD figure comes from a search summary that cites the RBA as of 15 October 2026. I did not open the RBA page directly, and a third-party site reported 0.6947 for 16 October, so verify the rate on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Caribbean resort and tourist towns with similar pricing, such as Montego Bay and Negril in Jamaica, and general Jamaican resort-town restaurant and lodging price levels, with imported goods and tourist-area markups.
